newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 10.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Chinese trade mission visits Ivory Coast - Presidential decree outlines new rules on insuring imports to Ivory Coast; importers no longer obliged to use Ivorian registered insurance company.
- Teachers union SYNESCI, close to opposition Ivorian Popular Front, calls three-day strike from March 18 to protest about pay and conditions.

- Doctor and psychologist say panic over shrinking or disappearing penises in Ivory Coast is baseless; say idea that alleged sorcerers can have this affect on people is nonsense - Producers and buyers of tropical farm produce and cereals in Ivory Coast set up union to represent their interest
